response.overview: To escalate an issue with Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL) ☎ +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada), submit an official case through the Norwegian Cruise Line Case Submission Form or call customer service at ☎ +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) to request a supervisor.  Escalation Steps  • Document the issue: Gather your reservation number, ship name, sail date, stateroom number, photos/timestamps, and notes of prior interactions. • Submit one case online: File a single case per reservation (not per guest) via the Norwegian Cruise Line Case Submission Form to avoid processing delays. • Call and request a supervisor: Reach out to NCL customer service at ☎ +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) (Mon–Fri 8am–Midnight ET, Sat–Sun 9am–9pm ET) or the corporate office at ☎ +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) (Mon–Fri 8:30am–5pm ET) and ask to speak with a supervisor if front-line agents cannot resolve it  While You Are Onboard (Best Option)
